reading.zh: 从左到右：先预检受影响的在途单据，再看五类模板契约与错误码字典，然后交给导入引擎（全量校验报告、单事务幂等 upsert、逐行数据域 fail-closed 闸门），最后走仅管理员可用的导出。
reading.en: Left to right: preview the affected in-flight documents, read the five template contracts, run the shared import engine (validation report, single-transaction idempotent upsert, per-row fail-closed data-scope gate), then export through the administrator-only path.
